verdict.rationale: Figma markets an AI agent that generates design directions, diagrams, and can summarize data into slides (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34, figma-comm-9), but hands-on community feedback specifically says FigJam's AI tools are 'really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), directly contradicting the polished vendor narrative. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of insight/suggestion quality, resolution of the broken/buggy AI complaints, and clearer documentation of what 'insights from data' actually means beyond generative design suggestions.
